verified: Switzerland's Federal Roads Office (FEDRO) awarded the 32 locations it tendered in January 2026 for 82 truck charging stations along national roads, split into three lots — Lot 1 to Fastned, Lot 2 to Obornes, Lot 3 to Milence — electrive reported.
unconfirmed: the rollout timetable — first stations in 2030 and all 82 by 2035 — appears in other outlets' coverage (mobility-360, The EV Report, IN Power) but not in electrive's report, and no charging power, contract terms, pricing or site-by-site details were disclosed.

verified: 瑞士联邦公路局（FEDRO）将 2026 年 1 月招标的 32 个地点分配给三家企业，第 1 标段归 Fastned、第 2 标段归 Obornes、第 3 标段归 Milence，沿国道规划共 82 座卡车充电站；这是合同授予，不是已投运的充电设施（electrive 根据 FEDRO 公告报道）。
unconfirmed: 各站点的具体位置、充电功率与单站规模未在报道中说明；首批站点 2030 年投运、2035 年前建成 82 座的进度来自 mobility-360、The EV Report 等二手报道，FEDRO 原始公告的相应时间表尚未经独立核实。

titles.en: Switzerland awards 32 truck charging sites to Fastned, Obornes and Milence
titles.zh: 瑞士授出32处卡车充电站点，Fastned、Obornes与Milence分获三标段
